biotools.summary: VertexWiseR is an R package designed to simplify vertex-wise analyses of whole-brain and hippocampal surfaces, making neuroimaging accessible to a wider range of researchers. It facilitates the compression of surface data into shareable files and provides tools for statistical analyses without requiring specialized operating environments.
